subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should this PR be refreshed as a separate token progress bar now that current main already has a composer context usage ring, or should the idea be folded into the existing context notice and broader quota issues?
rationale: The remaining choice is not just mechanical: current main already has a freshness-aware context indicator, and a second meter could duplicate or contradict that UI unless maintainers choose the desired surface.

options.title: Integrate With Existing Notice
options.body: Refresh the branch onto the current chat composer and reuse or share the existing freshness-aware context model so stale-session behavior stays consistent.

options.title: Drop Separate Bar
options.body: Close or abandon this separate meter if the current context ring is the accepted composer UI and keep broader provider quota work on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/62167.

options.title: Define A New Stale State
options.body: Keep a distinct bar only after documenting and testing whether stale totals are hidden, shown as updating, or rendered as unknown.

recommendation.title: Integrate With Existing Notice
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch onto the current chat composer and reuse or share the existing freshness-aware context model so stale-session behavior stays consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev merged the persistent Control UI context usage work and authored this maintainer-labeled follow-up feature branch.
